rationale: Per Guide Section 18.1 and Section 9.4, only heads that clear strict qualification may be used in downstream research. In the locked evaluation, qualification status on H90 is Volatility: NOT_QUALIFIED, Path Efficiency: NOT_QUALIFIED, Joint: NOT_QUALIFIED. Therefore, predictive-regime parameter selection on joint regimes is strictly prohibited. Furthermore, per Section 18.3 and Section 18.5, WFO execution requires >=128 attempted strategy trials/cutoff across 2-3 dimensions, >=12 paired-valid WFO folds, timeline evidence, and financial domain gates, none of which are satisfied in this model-first study. Therefore, the WFO Bridge is CLOSED.
